_doc: THE ENGINE THIS CONTRACT MODULE'S CLIENT BINDS (engine-apk-split move 6). Same shape as an app's build.json::engines, declared here because the client lives here: every consumer (Cloud Drive, Mail, Camera, Media Center, Office) compiles this module and none of them compiles the engine. `fleet` is the Store row in aa_cloud-superapp/data/constellation-fleet.json from which build.gradle resolves the package (an unknown id fails the build) into BuildConfig and the merged <queries>; `action` finds the service ({package} substituted at build time, matching the engine manifest's ${applicationId}.ENGINE); `min_contract` is the lowest engine CONTRACT that answers every method ImageScanEngine calls, read through PackageManager BEFORE binding.

image._doc_method_contracts: #772 a method that needs a newer engine than the floor every consumer needs: recognize and models arrived in contract 2, so only a call to them asks for it and a barcode-only consumer keeps working against a contract-1 engine.
